differential.name: Anemia of chronic kidney disease (normocytic, normochromic)
differential.rationale: Documented anemia, CKD stage 4, low‑normal albumin, and lack of other hematologic abnormalities point to CKD‑related anemia.

differential.name: Secondary hyperparathyroidism (CKD‑MBD)
differential.rationale: CKD stage 4 with low‑normal calcium and normal phosphate (not shown) suggests dysregulated PTH as a common complication.

differential.name: Ischemic heart disease
differential.rationale: Hypertension, metabolic syndrome, diabetes, and CKD markedly increase atherosclerotic risk; chest discomfort is often atypical in this population.

differential.name: Obstructive sleep apnea syndrome contributing to resistant hypertension
differential.rationale: Known OSA diagnosis, hypertension, and daytime fatigue make it a relevant comorbidity affecting overall status.
